title: Alpcour Reclining Stadium Seat w/ Armrests (25" Wide, Royal Blue)

amazon_match_notes: Woot offer ASIN B07PN5M2HT verified by the checker as Alpcour APC-RSSAWBL (UPC 661094056535), 25-inch wide, Royal Blue.
writeup: Alpcour's 25-inch wide reclining stadium seat in Royal Blue (model APC-RSSAWBL) is $47.99 brand new at Woot. Alpcour's own site charges $99.95 for the exact same seat. It's a padded bleacher seat with a reclining back and fold-down armrests, a nice upgrade for long games. Only 1 was left when we checked, limit 3 per customer.
